requirements.title: Great-circle distance
requirements.text: Leg distance shall be the great-circle distance in nautical miles on a sphere of radius 3440.065 NM.

requirements.title: Bearing range
requirements.text: Initial bearing shall be expressed in true degrees normalized to the range [0, 360).

requirements.title: SRN-1 record types
requirements.text: The navigation data reader shall load airport (AP), waypoint (WP), and navaid (NV) records from SRN-1 files and ignore other record types.

requirements.title: Comment lines
requirements.text: Lines that start with '*' and blank lines shall be ignored.

requirements.title: Malformed records
requirements.text: A malformed record shall be skipped without stopping the load of the remaining records.

requirements.title: Duplicate identifiers
requirements.text: When an identifier appears more than once, the last record in the file shall be used. Lookup shall ignore case and surrounding spaces.

requirements.title: Route legs
requirements.text: A route shall consist of one leg between each pair of consecutive fixes.

requirements.title: Total distance
requirements.text: Total route distance shall be the sum of the distances of all legs.

requirements.title: Time enroute
requirements.text: Estimated time enroute shall be total distance divided by ground speed. A ground speed of zero or less shall be rejected.

requirements.title: Trip fuel
requirements.text: Trip fuel shall be time enroute multiplied by the fuel burn rate.

requirements.title: Contingency fuel
requirements.text: Contingency fuel shall be the configured percentage (default 5%) of trip fuel only.

requirements.title: Final reserve and total
requirements.text: Final reserve shall be the configured minutes (default 30) at the burn rate. Total fuel shall be trip plus contingency plus reserve.

requirements.title: Plan report
requirements.text: The plan report shall list every leg with its distance and course, the total distance, the time enroute, and the fuel plan.

requirements.title: Altitude input
requirements.text: Cruise altitude input shall accept FLnnn or a number of feet. The software shall not evaluate or execute altitude input as code.

requirements.title: Export file names
requirements.text: Export file names shall contain only the characters [A-Za-z0-9_-]. Exported files shall stay inside the output directory.

requirements.title: Archive creation
requirements.text: Archive creation shall not pass user input to a command shell.

requirements.title: Cached plan data
requirements.text: Cached plan data shall be stored in a data-only format. The software shall not deserialize untrusted data into executable objects.

requirements.title: Upload credentials
requirements.text: Upload credentials shall be read from the SKYROUTE_UPLOAD_TOKEN environment variable and shall not be stored in source code.
